violations.text: Cucumbers were observed with an accumulation of mold build-up in the walk-in cooler. Cucumbers were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Dead mouse was observed on trap under the dry storage rack. Dead mouse was removed from establishment at the time of inspection. No other activity observed at the time of inspection. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control and increase pest control as frequently as needed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
